growth-rate.def: How fast a quantity grows, as a percent of its size per unit of time: a growth rate of 2% a year adds 2 for every 100 each year.

rule-of-70.def: A shortcut for doubling time: divide 70 by the percent growth rate. At 2% a year, 70 ÷ 2 = 35 years.

doubling-time.def: The time a quantity growing at a steady percent rate takes to double, about 70 divided by the percent growth rate.
